claims.claim: Unified State and Human Surface expose a deterministic 32-item-bounded collection of exact outstanding-finding identities, omit implicit selectors for multi-finding authoring, and fail closed when the bound is exceeded.
Prospective predecessor and execution-base metadata use strict canonical parsers, while legacy remediation artifacts retain reviewed-SHA equality semantics.

Remediation admission and preflight derive and expose an exact cumulative execution base from canonical correction lineage and frontier state, enforce safe main ancestry, persist it separately from the semantic predecessor, and start execution from that base.

Prospective cumulative CODE_FIX completion, changed-files validation, and modification-scope enforcement are measured from Run.base_sha while semantic remediation validation remains bound to the original reviewed SHA.

Publication independently validates semantic predecessor identity, cumulative execution-base identity and ancestry, operational correction lineage, final candidate binding, safe main containment, and the empty-frontier gate.
The implementation adds no finding selection, retry, reroute, fallback, automatic integration, authority transfer, or verification-ownership change.
